veranderings.na: kyk of die water daarin intrek
veranderings.rede: Without 'daarin' it is unclear what the water soaks into; the pronoun makes the sentence complete and natural.

veranderings.voor: buig nie so maklik soos die sak nie
veranderings.na: buig nie so maklik as die sak nie
veranderings.rede: An equal comparison with 'so' takes 'as' in standard Afrikaans, and the lesson elsewhere uses 'net so hard as' and 'net so goed in as'.
'aan iets skeur' is not idiomatic; 'skeur' takes a direct object, and 'probeer' keeps the meaning that the material stays whole.

veranderings.voor: Absorberende materiaal trek water by homself in
veranderings.rede: 'by homself' is a wooden, English-like addition; 'trek water in' already says it is taken into the material.

veranderings.voor: Materiaal wat water by homself intrek
veranderings.rede: Same wooden 'by homself' as in the study text; keep the definition and the block consistent.
